purpose: Overview requirements for doc-link: purpose, background, scope, responsibility boundaries, glossary, non-functional requirements, errors, decisions and open items for ID-based document search and index management.
summary: Purpose: replace DocAdvisor with a plugin managing documents by permanent DLIDs instead of paths
Background: limits of path-keyed ToC and file-level hashes
Overall flow diagram: check-dlid, embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs, check-impact, with project management AI and user
Document search flow with ToC rebuild check and user choice
Glossary of terms such as DLID, document ID, section ID, ToC, content hash, ToC identification key
Scope and responsibility boundary: doc-link writes only DLIDs, project management AI fixes documents
Non-functional requirements NFR-001 to NFR-008: consistency, determinism, idempotency, write boundary, diagnosability
Error candidates and findings that do not block ToC confirmation
Decision table D-001 to D-058 covering ID format, hashes, references, search policy and operation flow
Open items table, all resolved or deferred to design
tasks: Understanding the overall purpose and scope of doc-link
Writing or reviewing requirement documents for doc-link
Looking up decisions D-001 to D-058 or glossary terms
Reviewing non-functional requirements and error handling
Defining the operation flow of check-dlid, embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs and check-impact
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 総論
